identity_semantics.federal_unitid: The entity’s OWN six-digit IPEDS UNITID, or NULL. Never synthetic, never an NCES/College Navigator location code (15111102, 14570703), never a guess. UNIQUE across entities.
identity_semantics.parent_unitid: IPEDS UNITID of the federal institution a campus/branch entity is reported under; the only sanctioned way two entities share a UNITID; set only when proven.
identity_semantics.athletics_entity_id: Internal, stable, opaque id of the athletics institution/campus that recruits (AE-U<unitid> for a single institution; AE-X-<slug> for a modeled exception). Never copied into a federal UNITID field.
identity_semantics.programme_identity: athletics_entity_id + sport, materialised as one active colleges row whose colleges.id is the programme id.
identity_semantics.campus_label: Human-readable campus disambiguator; required for campus/branch entities.
identity_semantics.colleges_unitid: Legacy federal UNITID for the programme’s institution; unchanged by the entity layer; must agree with its entity (federal or parent) or be NULL.

model_decision.question: Can the current canonical ids distinguish these entities without corrupting federal UNITID semantics?
model_decision.answer: PARTLY. colleges.id (UNIQUE name+sport) already distinguishes programme ROWS, but the reconciler, athletics_domains, institution_aliases and every coverage/division measure key on UNITID, so entities sharing or lacking a UNITID collapse.
